title: Finiteness of the normalization and a regular dense open from the existence of a regular alteration
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that a Noetherian integral scheme admitting an alteration from a regular scheme has finite normalization and a dense open which is regular (statement lines 3746-3752). The proof (proof lines 3753-3773) shows finiteness of the normalizations through the global sections of the alteration and finds a regular dense open by descending regularity along a generically finite flat morphism. H2: two complete independent arguments.
